title: The ethics of making and choosing images — Image Wiki

rules.rule: If an image implies a claim it does not carry, check if the frame excludes context outside the picture's edge.
rules.evidence: A chosen frame. The queue. Nothing is added; the edge of the picture does the arguing.

rules.rule: If an image features identifiable people, ask if they would recognize themselves and agree to being shown like this.
rules.evidence: Would this person recognise themselves? Did they agree to this use, or to being photographed at all?

rules.rule: If a caption states nothing was edited, verify if anything was arranged, moved, retouched, or retimed before approval.
rules.evidence: Was anything arranged, moved, retouched or retimed — and would the caption still be true if you said so?
